nameOrigin: a species of fish, occasionally carnivorous

pokedexEntries.ru: CARVANHA’s strongly developed jaws and its sharply pointed fangs pack the destructive power to rip out boat hulls. Many boats have been attacked and sunk by this POKéMON.

pokedexEntries.sa: If anything invades CARVANHA’s territory, it will swarm and tear at the intruder with its pointed fangs. On its own, however, this POKéMON turns suddenly timid.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It lives in massive rivers that course through jungles. It swarms prey that enter its territory.

pokedexEntries.em: CARVANHA attack ships in swarms, making them sink. Although it is said to be a very vicious POKéMON, it timidly flees as soon as it finds itself alone.

pokedexEntries.dpp: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.

pokedexEntries.hgss: They form packs to attack boats and rip out their hulls to sink them. They live in rivers in the jungle.

pokedexEntries.or: Carvanha’s strongly developed jaws and its sharply pointed fangs pack the destructive power to rip out boat hulls. Many boats have been attacked and sunk by this Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.as: If anything invades Carvanha’s territory, it will swarm and tear at the intruder with its pointed fangs. On its own, however, this Pokémon turns suddenly timid.

pokedexEntries.su: Each school has its own territory. Any intruders are mercilessly attacked with fangs bared.

pokedexEntries.mo: If they scent the faintest trace of blood, they rush to attack en masse. When alone, they’re rather cowardly.

pokedexEntries.us: They’re such cowards that they won’t hunt alone. When five or so of them get together, they suddenly turn ferocious!

pokedexEntries.um: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.

pokedexEntries.sw: It won’t attack while it’s alone—not even if it spots prey. Instead, it waits for other Carvanha to join it, and then the Pokémon attack as a group.

pokedexEntries.sh: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.
